facts.fact: Addis Fortune reports that officials recommend Fayda's verification tools to check national ID cards, and that Document Authentication & Registration Service Kirkos branch fully uses national IDs for property services.

ETH.note: Only says Fayda's integration of services including birth certificates aims to streamline processes; no link stated.
Nothing on the digital civil register.

facts.fact: Addis Fortune says Ethiopia's Digital Identification Proclamation provides that digital identification is a right, not an obligation, and that the managing institution cannot mandate registration though regulators may require it for specific services.

ETH.note: About 10 million registered is stated with no population or share.
Only that Fayda is built on MOSIP; who operates and maintains it is not stated.
Institutions adopting the national ID are named but no public register keyed on the number is stated.

facts.fact: Addis Fortune reports the National ID Program (Fayda) is issuing unique identification numbers and cards, with about 10 million people registered and enrolment running since September 2022.

systems.owner: National ID Program, Prime Minister's Office

facts.fact: Addis Fortune reports Document Authentication & Registration Service Kirkos fully transitioned to national IDs for services, particularly fixed property, after forged ID sales.
Addis Fortune reports the Ministry of Revenues, the Federal Public Procurement & Property Authority, Ethio telecom, Ethiopian Airlines and commercial banks have adopted the national ID.

ETH.note: Nothing on digital entry of births or deaths at registration offices.
